title: Cart service stalls under peak load
summary: Redis ran out of connection capacity during the Monday morning traffic spike and cart service requests started timing out after 8 seconds.

title: Auth requests blocked on Redis
summary: The authentication service could not borrow a single Redis connection because the entire pool was consumed by idle clients.

title: User API hangs during Redis election
summary: After a Redis primary node went down the user API retried immediately on every connection which amplified the failover and kept the outage going.

title: Cache service retry amplification after node flap
summary: Redis Sentinel promoted a replica but the cache service hammered it with retries instead of backing off so the failover storm lasted twelve minutes.

title: Event ingestion backs up on Kafka broker storage
summary: Kafka brokers hit 99 percent disk utilization because the analytics topic retention was set to seven days and producers were rejected.

title: Streaming service cannot write to Kafka
summary: The streaming service stopped producing events because Kafka storage was full and the broker refused all new writes.

title: Partner callback burns CPU in retry spiral
summary: The billing service reached 100 percent CPU because every failed partner callback retried instantly in an infinite loop with no backoff strategy.

title: Worker process stuck at full CPU after gateway errors
summary: A worker kept retrying the same gateway call without any delay and pinned the CPU at full utilization within two minutes.

title: Reports API degraded after new SQL query deployed
summary: PostgreSQL latency jumped from 12ms to 3 seconds because the latest release added a status filter that forced a full table scan on the reports table.

title: Inventory service slow reads from database
summary: The inventory service saw elevated latency because PostgreSQL queries scanned the entire product table without the right index after a schema migration.

title: Mesh gateway returns 502 after certificate rotation missed
summary: Nginx on the internal mesh started serving 502 errors because its TLS certificate for upstream connections had expired without rotation.

title: Internal service calls fail on stale TLS cert
summary: All internal gRPC calls through the service mesh failed because nginx was presenting an expired TLS certificate to upstream services.

title: Search indexing blocked by disk exhaustion
summary: The Elasticsearch cluster went read-only because the underlying disk reached 95 percent utilization and refused new index operations.

title: Log aggregation stops writing to storage
summary: The log aggregation service crashed its write path because the attached persistent volume ran out of disk space.

title: Product listing API returns 504 on cache timeout
summary: The product API started returning 504 errors because Redis timed out after every client attempted to read product cache during a flash sale.

title: Kubernetes pods restarting after OOM
summary: The data processing pods kept getting killed by OOM because the new batch job allocated more heap than the configured memory limit.

title: Recommendation service heap keeps growing
summary: The recommendation service memory usage climbed steadily over 24 hours until it hit the container memory limit and the pod was OOM killed.

title: Order pipeline stuck waiting on Postgres
summary: The order pipeline halted because PostgreSQL connection slots were exhausted by long-running analytical queries from the reporting service.

title: Inventory sync lagging behind writes
summary: The inventory replica fell several minutes behind the primary because a large batch update saturated the disk IO on the database server.

title: API gateway health check failing on DNS
summary: The API gateway health checks started failing because the internal DNS resolver returned NXDOMAIN for the service discovery endpoints.
